summary: Added sdk/reports (progression.py, __init__.py). compute_progression_metrics groups journal events by account alias and UTC day of finished_at and returns DayMetrics: counts by outcome for attempted events, failed (error class recorded), skipped and dry-run counts, verified_success_rate, the attempt window and elapsed hours, resources gained and spent from *_delta costs with resource_samples, gained per hour, and a failure ledger of contradicted, unknown or errored attempts. Rates and per-hour figures are None without a sample; dry-run and skipped events never count as attempts. to_json and to_markdown render the report, including the failure ledger. Added 6 tests with temporary journals and docs/baseline/progression-metrics.md.

contract_status_changes.before: Journal events had only per-account outcome counts
contract_status_changes.after: Per-day scorecard inputs (verified success, failures, resources per hour) with sample sizes, windows and a failure ledger

residual_risks: Account growth velocity and operator time saved, both part of the R2 exit, need the manual baseline from the blocked live trial.
Resources per hour uses the attempt window, which understates the time between scheduled runs; cross-day rates need the live trial's observation window.
